title: Foundations of Computational Interaction
description: Foundations of Computational Interaction version 0.5.1 (public packaging release for theory 0.5.0). An interdisciplinary research program for formally describing, measuring, modeling, and predicting human-computer interaction. Includes the versioned knowledge system of record and a C11 reference substrate for a deterministic subset of the ontology. Research corpus under CC BY 4.0; code and schemas under Apache-2.0. See LICENSES.md. Author: Zachary Shallbetter (ORCID 0009-0009-9450-3429).
